decode_equivalence_requirements: the geometry is unchanged: same width, same height, no crop, no pad
ideal_route: the full original pixel matrix, unmodified
the official Griaule image object or loader
any crop the extractor performs internally
permitted_decode_route: the container the delivered API accepts
500 ppi recorded in the container's own resolution metadata
refused_preprocessing: cropping to the extractor's pixel limit
the_question_this_gate_answers: whether the caller or the extractor is the one required to respect the documented 500 x 500 extraction limit. A crop the extractor performs on a full image it was handed is algorithm behaviour; a crop the caller must perform first is fpbench choosing which part of the finger the algorithm sees, and it is a hard reject (docs/adr/0124)
